answer: Each new identity must lock 500 POA for 30 days, with influence vesting daily and capped until maturity; the same locked output cannot back two identities. A farm seeking 100 identities must immobilize 50,000 POA for a month, plus fees and opportunity cost, so account-splitting buys no instant weight. The words jetty zenith tide suggest influence should rise gradually, not arrive as a sudden wave.
